resources.string: Reorder this character\'s tabs. The same order arranges the panes on a wide screen. Saved on this device only.
This sheet doesn\'t say what %1$s is. Turn this on to get an equip control for it.
You can undo this straight afterwards.
Coins are always here. Tap + to put something else on this sheet.
Reorder the sections on this tab. Hiding one folds its items into Gear — nothing is ever hidden from you. Saved on this device only.
Your coins are still on the character sheet
Applies inside each section and container. The section order above and your coins are unaffected.
not used in sheet order, choose Name, Weight or Value first
Nothing in the list matches. Tap “Custom item” to type one in.
Adding an item can\'t be undone in this version.

Concentration check. DC %1$d, half of %2$d damage, minimum 10. Concentrating on %3$s.
Showing the last saved copy — synced %1$s.
This sheet has no spell slots, resources or conditions MageHand can follow. Open the Sheet tab to see everything.
Not connected — the tracker is showing the last saved copy of this sheet, so spending, healing and resting are unavailable until it reconnects.
Nothing on this tracker is restored by this rest.
The server also applies whatever else this sheet restores on a long rest — hit points, hit dice and any rest triggers on it.
Everything MageHand has sent to DiceCloud since you opened this character. Only the most recent change can be undone.
Reorder, hide and pin rows for this character. Saved on this device only — nothing is sent to DiceCloud.
Reorder this character\'s rows. Add or remove rows by editing the character.
…and %1$d more. Narrow the search to see them.
Your password is sent once to sign you in and is never stored. The sign-in token it returns is kept encrypted on this device.
Characters you make on this device stay on it. You can sign in later from Settings without losing them.
Tap + to create one in DiceCloud.
Tap + to make one on this device.
Signed out by the server — sign in again
Signed out — tap for connection details
Connected to DiceCloud. Changes you make here save straight away.
MageHand can\'t reach DiceCloud right now.
DiceCloud rejected this account\'s saved sign-in. Sign in again from Settings — waiting will not fix this one.
This sheet has never finished syncing on this device.
MageHand keeps retrying on its own; this only asks it to try now.
Signing out removes the token from this device only. DiceCloud has no \"log out everywhere\" API — do that on the website if you need it.
The sign-in token is deleted from this device. Your characters stay on the server.
Most sheets\' toggles are build machinery — hidden unless you use them.

Smaller, already at the smallest size
Larger, already at the largest size
Spell slots, resources and items you want on the tracker, and actions you want to use.

Actions logged by DiceCloud appear here, including uses made in MageHand. Tracker edits — spending a slot, adjusting an item — are not logged by the server.
